subject.title: feat(context-engine): report compaction successors as typed session targets

question: Should OpenClaw accept `CompactResult.result.sessionTarget` as the next public compaction-successor contract now, while keeping deprecated `sessionFile` compatibility for shipped plugins?
rationale: This is an additive but public plugin-SDK contract change; source review supports the implementation shape, but automation should not make the permanent SDK direction decision alone.

options.title: Accept additive typed target
options.body: Proceed with `sessionTarget` as the preferred SDK contract, keep `sessionFile` populated for compatibility, and require exact-head checks plus real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause API expansion
options.body: Keep the PR open but defer the public field until maintainers confirm the broader non-file-backed session storage direction.

options.title: Keep helper internal only
options.body: Ask for a narrower branch that centralizes host resolution without adding a public SDK field yet.

recommendation.title: Accept additive typed target
recommendation.body: Proceed with `sessionTarget` as the preferred SDK contract, keep `sessionFile` populated for compatibility, and require exact-head checks plus real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent run-session-target seam and have the clearest recent history on the typed session direction.
